checks.name: required_columns
checks.expectation: all eight contracted columns are present

checks.name: timestamp_parse
checks.expectation: every timestamp reads as an ISO-8601 date and time

checks.name: required_values_complete
checks.expectation: required fields contain no missing values

checks.name: exact_row_uniqueness
checks.expectation: no row repeats every field of another row

checks.name: business_key_uniqueness
checks.expectation: each timestamp and line_id combination appears at most once

checks.name: known_line_ids
checks.expectation: line_id must be one of the three expected production lines

checks.name: positive_energy
checks.expectation: energy_kwh must be greater than zero for each hourly record

checks.name: rejects_within_output
checks.expectation: rejected_units must be non-negative and cannot exceed units produced

checks.name: downtime_range
checks.expectation: downtime_min is between 0 and 60 minutes per hourly period

checks.name: motor_temperature_review_range
checks.expectation: motor_temp_c sits between 40 and 100 under the course review rule

checks.name: shift_matches_hour
checks.expectation: shift is Day from 06:00 to 17:59 and Night from 18:00 to 05:59

checks.name: expected_line_hour_coverage
checks.expectation: each expected line has 24 distinct hourly records
